projects.title: NBoard — Indic keyboard
projects.explanation: A swipe-based native Java keyboard supporting 3+ Indic languages, including conjunct letter support and a language-agnostic layout system.
projects.thoughtProcess: The project focused on separating language behaviour from the keyboard structure so new layouts could be introduced through minimal file changes rather than a rewrite of the input system.
projects.resultsSummary: Produced a flexible native keyboard concept with multi-language support and a structure that could be extended without changing the core interaction model.

projects.title: Genetic algorithm timetable
projects.explanation: A constraint-aware genetic algorithm for university timetable scheduling across multiple student groups.
projects.thoughtProcess: The approach modelled timetable generation as a search problem, using constraints and candidate populations to explore schedules instead of relying on a single manually designed arrangement.
projects.resultsSummary: Created an optimisation-based timetable generator capable of handling competing constraints and producing more efficient university schedules.

projects.title: Enterprise workflow platform
projects.explanation: A scalable workflow application built with Spring Boot and Angular, including REST APIs, real-time collaboration, versioning, locking, and threaded comments.
projects.thoughtProcess: The platform was designed around modular backend services, a flexible workflow engine, and clear ownership boundaries so changing enterprise requirements could be handled without rebuilding the entire system.
projects.resultsSummary: Delivered a production workflow platform with 50+ backend APIs and collaboration features supporting complex form-driven processes.
